# InternoZero - Full English Immersion Hub & Coworking

> InternoZero is the first Full English Immersion Hub and flexible coworking space located in Campi Bisenzio (Florence, Tuscany, Italy). Designed for freelancers, remote workers, companies, and international professionals, InternoZero provides a 100% English-speaking environment for working, networking, and professional growth.

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Primary Category:** Coworking Space & Professional Immersion Hub
- **Location:** Campi Bisenzio, Metropolitan City of Florence, Tuscany, Italy
- **Unique Selling Proposition (USP):** First full English immersion work and community ecosystem in the Florence/Tuscany area.
- **Languages Spoken:** English (Primary operational language), Italian

## Main Services
- **English Immersion Community:** Work atmosphere designed for professionals seeking to practice and refine business English through daily interaction, events, and networking.
- **Coworking & Flexible Desks:** Hot desks, dedicated desks, and private offices with high-speed fiber internet.
- **Corporate & Language Programs:** Tailored business English workshops, language coaching, and international networking sessions.

## Location & Accessibility
- **City:** Campi Bisenzio (FI), 50013, Italy
- **Region:** Tuscany (near Florence/Firenze, Pistoia and Prato)
- **Target Audience:** Digital nomads, remote workers, corporate teams, local professionals, and expats in Tuscany.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Where is InternoZero located?** InternoZero is based in Campi Bisenzio, strategically positioned between Florence and Prato in Tuscany.
- **What makes InternoZero different from other coworking spaces in Florence?** It is the first hub in the region combining flexible office space with an active, daily full English immersion environment.
